title: Multi-task learning on partially labeled datasets via invariant/equivariant semi-supervised learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.17624v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We investigate the potential of invariant and equivariant semi-supervised learning for addressing the challenges of training multi-task models on partially labeled datasets with differently structured output tasks. Specifically, we use the popular FixMatch method for invariant semi-supervised learning and its equivariant extension Dense FixMatch. We evaluate their performance on the Cityscapes and BDD100K datasets in the context of the prevalent object detection and semantic segmentation tasks in computer vision. We consider varying sizes of the subsets annotated for each task and different overlaps among them. Our results for both invariant and equivariant semi-supervised learning outperform supervised baselines in most situations, with the most significant improvements observed when fewer labeled samples are available for a task and generally better results for the latter approach. translated_title: 基于不变/等变半监督学习的部分标注数据集多任务学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究了不变和等变半监督学习在解决部分标注数据集上训练多任务模型的挑战方面的潜力，这些数据集具有不同结构的输出任务。具体而言，我们使用流行的FixMatch方法进行不变半监督学习，并使用其等变扩展Dense FixMatch。我们在计算机视觉中流行的目标检测和语义分割任务的背景下，在Cityscapes和BDD100K数据集上评估了它们的性能。我们考虑了每个任务标注子集的不同规模以及它们之间的不同重叠情况。我们的结果表明，在大多数情况下，不变和等变半监督学习的表现均优于监督基线，当某个任务的标注样本较少时改进最为显著，且等变方法通常能取得更好的结果。
tldr: 该研究将不变/等变半监督学习（FixMatch和Dense FixMatch）应用于部分标注数据集的多任务学习，在目标检测和语义分割任务上超越监督基线，尤其在标注样本稀缺时改进最显著。
en_tdlr: This study applies invariant/equivariant semi-supervised learning (FixMatch and Dense FixMatch) to multi-task learning on partially labeled datasets, outperforming supervised baselines on object detection and semantic segmentation, with the most significant improvements when labeled samples are scarce.
